definitions.static_start: first time >= target lock + 2s with target height held within 5mm continuously for 2s
definitions.lift_position_baseline: mean raw position over 2s before actual rise start
definitions.lift_window: actual rise start through 10s after actual low return
definitions.pitch: actual pitch minus nominal equilibrium angle
definitions.statistics: N=3 mean +/- unbiased sample SD; no significance test
